breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory preamble about grid conventions. It first gave a general rule, then an incorrect specific override for this task (`dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)`), which was then contradicted by the correct instruction in the numerical methods section (`dx=1/Nx`). The agent correctly resolved this by completely omitting the contradictory preamble and only stating the correct grid definition (`dx = 1 / Nx`), which is consistent with the ground truth's removal of the incorrect text.
